metaTitle: Custom Full Color Table Displays | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color table displays for trade shows and events. Full-color printing on runners and throws. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Full color table displays let you reproduce logos, photos, and intricate designs with photographic clarity. Unlike one- or two-color imprints, full color allows gradients, shadows, and detailed artwork that makes your booth stand out. Whether you need a 6' standard throw for a conference or a 57" runner for a registration table, these displays turn your table into a vibrant marketing asset. Durable polyester fabric ensures colors stay bright wash after wash.
heroAltText: Custom full color table displays with vibrant printed logos on table throws and runners for trade show marketing.
